purpose: Bind accepted CP123 TL1-TL9 reference authorities to a reusable research catalog, exhaustively enumerate a broad same-TL legal-build envelope, and make raw instrumentation validation a blocking acceptance gate before larger statistical studies.

optionalAxes: GP or Swarmer Missile Flight when available
buildEnvelope.missionAuxFiller: all residual Installation Space is explicitly recorded as zero-tactical-effect mission/AUX capacity
buildEnvelope.legality: combat Space must not exceed same-TL Hull Installation Space capacity

mixedTlPopulation.reason: CP124 establishes catalog, legality, and telemetry contracts first. Mixed/nonadjacent TL becomes a larger follow-on study once the foundation is accepted.

pipelineSmokePolicy: Zero-inference one-trial mirrors exercise every TL, all three Main Weapon families, GP Missile, and TL2+ Swarmer paths. Smoke outcomes are not balance evidence.

telemetryPolicy.missileOwnership: launches are attacker-side; terminal arrivals, guidance attempts, and missile hits are target-side
telemetryPolicy.damageLayerAccounting: raw damage, penetration contribution, Shield/Armor prevention/absorption, Integrity/Protection damage, Hull damage, and packet count remain separately observable
telemetryPolicy.damageControl: attempts, successes, and Hull restored are explicit raw counters even though Damage Control is not integrated into the CP124 combat smoke

blockingGates: exhaustive same-TL legal-build enumeration with explicit mission/AUX fill
Kinetic/Energy/Missile GP coverage at TL1-TL9 and Swarmer coverage at TL2-TL9
70 zero-weight pipeline smoke variants complete with zero trial errors
raw telemetry schema contains all required analysis primitives
25 C#/Python research parity fixtures remain green
no production C#/Godot or C# ScenarioRunner scenario-definition changes

consumerLimitations.internalCriticalSubsystemDamage: not consumed by Python ecology; production C# authority remains separate and critical cadence stays deferred
consumerLimitations.damageControlInCombat: raw Damage Control counters and deterministic profile resolution are validated, but DamCon is not scheduled into the 70-trial combat smoke
consumerLimitations.missileRangeExhaustion: the current Python ecology uses bounded ETA-to-terminal Flight travel rather than the C# moving-target range-exhaustion model; future studies needing range-exhaustion inference must use/extend a parity-validated consumer
consumerLimitations.optionalBranchMechanics: the exhaustive envelope covers the established executable Shield Hardener and baseline component axes; other CP123 optional/deferred branch mechanics remain registered reference concepts, not silently simulated
